title.narrative: Resilient connectivity and Urban Transport Accessibility Project

description.narrative: Drawing upon its international and regional experience, the Bank is in a strong position to support government in formulating strategies to address complex resilient infrastructure and urban transport management issues. The Project will contribute to improve safe and climate resilient connectivity, urban mobility and accessibility in selected areas and strengthen governance and planning framework.

The Project Development Objective is to (i) enhance climate-resilient rural connectivity in the South Peninsula, (ii) improve climate-resilient urban accessibility in Cap-Haitien and targeted urban areas, and (iii) enhance institutional capacity in the urban transport sector.

condition.narrative: Schedule 2, Section I., A. Institutional Arrangements1. The Recipient shall vest the overall responsibility for theimplementation of the Project in MTPTC. 2. The Recipient shall operate and maintain, at all times during the implementation ofthe Project, the UCE-MTPTC under the administrative authority of MTPTC, to be responsible for the day-to-day administration,overall planning, coordination, fiduciary, environmental and social, reporting and communication of Project activities, as furtherdetailed in the Project Operational Manual, with functions, staffing and resources satisfactory to the Association. 3. Withoutlimitation to paragraph 2 above, the Recipient shall appoint or recruit for the Project, not later than six (6) months after theEffective Date, or any later date agreed by the Association: (a) a project team leader responsible for supervising theimplementation of activities under Part 2 of the Project; (b) a procurement specialist; (c) an accountant; (d) a monitoring andevaluation specialist; (e) a social risk management specialist; (f) an environmental risk management specialist; (g) acommunication specialist; and (h) a gender specialist, all with qualifications, experience and terms of reference satisfactory tothe Association.

Schedule 2, Section IV. Other UndertakingsThe Recipient shall, not later than four (4) months after the Effective Date, or anylater date as agreed by the Association, hire an independent auditor under terms and conditions acceptable to the Association
